newsitem.title: USA: Bradley buys four malls for $25 million.
newsitem.headline: Bradley buys four malls for $25 million.

text.p: Bradley Real Estate Inc., a real estate investment trust, said Thursday it acquired four Midwest shopping centres in the past month for about $25 million.

"These acquisitions reflect Bradley's focus on grocery-anchored neighbourhood and community shopping centres located in both the primary and secondary markets in the Midwest," Chief Executive Tom D'Arcy said.
The acquisitions include the Martin's Bittersweet Plaza in Mishawaka, Ind.; Santa Fe Square in Olathe, Kan.; Warren Plaza in Dubuque, Iowa; and Roseville Centre in Roseville, Minn.
Bradley, based in Northbrook, Ill., owns 35 properties in 13 states with about 8 million square feet of rentable space.
Bradley's stock was unchanged at $17.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
